title: The Back Blocks of China: Shans, Kachins, and Irrawaddy Borderlands
title_english: The Back Blocks of China: Shans, Kachins, and Irrawaddy Borderlands
title_as: চীন আৰু ব্ৰহ্মদেশৰ সীমান্ত: শ্বান আৰু কচিন জনজীৱন
author: Robert Logan Jack, LL.D., F.G.S.
provenance: Edward Arnold, London; Cornell University Library Archive cu31924023225505
description: Eyewitness geographical and ethnographic expedition through the Upper Yangtze, Mekong, Salween, and Irrawaddy valleys into Burma, recording Southwestern Tai (Shan/Tai Mau) villages, Buddhist monasteries, pagodas, costume, and trans-border trade routes.
